limitations: Node timings measure pure renderer JavaScript with a coordinate sink, not Canvas rasterization or native FPS.
Pixel parity covers 94 real-canvas cases and 85248000 RGBA pixels; exact command parity covers 1344 cases.
Initial stacked-canvas timings are discarded; use only the later same-visible-canvas ABBA submission timings.
Canvas submission timings include JavaScript and enqueue/backpressure effects; they do not measure GPU completion or native desktop smoothness.
Unchanged aperture timing varies, so small timing differences must be treated as noisy.
